content:
You extract one relationship between two known characters from a single piece of imported character-card content. Return a single RelationshipCandidate JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- source_name: one of the two related characters' names, copied EXACTLY as spelled in the supplied known_characters list.
- target_name: the other related character's name, copied EXACTLY as spelled in the supplied known_characters list - must be different from source_name.
- label: a short label for the relationship (e.g. "childhood friends", "rivals", "secret admirer").
- description: a short, self-contained description of the relationship's nature and history - written as our own prose, not a copy-paste of the source.

Local-model rules:
- Both names must be copied exactly from known_characters - never invent, translate, or abbreviate a name differently, and never pick the same name for both fields.
- If the content doesn't clearly involve two distinct known characters, still do your best to pick the two most clearly implied - but never invent a name that isn't in known_characters.
